title: A bounded LLM mutation beats its own fitted parent at matched fitting (absorbs R-001)
hypothesis: Averaged over the six frozen fittable-lane children of logs/two_lane_search, a child fitted and rollout-selected exactly as its parent wins more fresh held-out episodes than the parent, because its one structural change adds control that fitting the parent's own parameters cannot reach.

prediction.against: each child's own parent, refitted with identical demonstrations, objective (deterministic_mse), budget 1000, checkpoints {0,500,1000}, probe cases (development 40-49) and fitting seed 2611; checkpoints selected by probe rollouts, never by loss
prediction.rationale: Parents already reach 0.82-0.98 fitted, so the headroom is small; 0.05 is the smallest average gain that would justify an LLM step. The paired t interval is computed over the 50 placement-level averages of the six child-minus-parent differences, not over 300 observations, because the six pairs share placements. Per-pair differences are reported descriptively, not tested.

code_changes: scripts/compare_child_vs_parent.py (new, only if scripts/qualify_fittable_bank.py cannot express matched parent/child fitting; scoring reuses lares.eval via scripts/evaluate_on_fresh_manifest.py's manifest builder)

falsified_by: Interval upper bound <= 0 refutes any positive average added value; an upper bound below 0.05 refutes the predicted magnitude; an interval that includes zero with a positive mean is inconclusive, resolved only by a further predeclared fresh-case batch.
open_question_refs: DEBUG_PROGRESS 'Two-lane search, first live run': child versus fitted parent
RESEARCH_HANDOFF 'Two-lane search, first live run (2026-10-13, gpt-6.1-sol)'
R-001 (merged: two-lane winner vs gpt-6.1-sol baseline winner on the same 2610 cases, reported as a secondary control)

controls.note: control is each child's own parent refitted identically; the metric is already child minus parent, so the parent-vs-itself control is 0 by construction

result.notes: Primary: placement-level paired t over 50 fresh cases (pool seed 2610), each the mean of 6 child-minus-parent success differences: -0.020, t95 [-0.046, +0.006], p=0.135. Upper bound +0.006 is below the 0.05 threshold. All 11 fits (fit seed 2611, identical demos/objective/budget/checkpoints/probe dev 40-49) selected step 1000; none rejected fitting. Every child's source rebuilt its run initial state exactly. Per pair (descriptive): cand5 (geometry scope) +0.14 (7/0/43); cand0 -0.16 (0/8/42); cand2 -0.08; cand4 -0.02; cand1 and cand3 tie their parents on all 50 cases in success, though returns differ (max per-case |diff| ~80), so they are behaviourally distinct but not better. Secondary R-001: two-lane winner gen0_cand1_a0 (refitted with seed 2611, not the run's seed-0 state, as the protocol states) minus baseline gen0_cand2_a1 (its promotion-tested candidate, saved zero-shot state): +0.980 t95 [+0.940, +1.020], but the winner ties its own fitted parent, so the gain belongs to the seed bank plus fitting, not the LLM mutation. Deviations: the run was recorded against HEAD f7e9f74 with the new script uncommitted (committed with this ledger update); seeds 2610/2611 were reserved locally before the run; expert reference not scored (dropped from the revised 930-episode budget). Episodes: 330 probe + 600 evaluation = 930.

verdicts.reasoning: Placement-level paired success difference (child minus its identically refitted parent, mean over 6 pairs, 50 fresh cases from pool seed 2610) is -0.020, t95 [-0.046, +0.006]. The predeclared falsifier says an upper bound below 0.05 refutes the predicted magnitude; +0.006 is far below it. The interval only just includes zero, so a small positive average effect is not strictly excluded, but the point estimate is negative. Per pair it is mixed and descriptive: one child gains (cand5, geometry scope, +0.14, 7/0/43), one loses (cand0, -0.16, 0/8/42), two tie exactly on success. All 11 fits selected step 1000, so fitting worked equally for both sides. The two-lane winner beats the zero-success baseline by +0.98 (R-001 secondary), but it ties its own parent on all 50 cases, so that gain is the seed bank plus rollout-selected fitting, not the LLM mutation.
verdicts.next_experiment: Treat the seed bank plus rollout-selected fitting as the operative method. If the LLM step is kept, test only the one positive signal (geometry-scope mutation of simple_damped_push) as its own predeclared idea on a fresh pool seed, or drop the fittable-lane LLM mutation and spend the budget on fitting/search arms.

verdicts.reasoning: The named matched-parent control was measured: mean child success was 0.890 versus parent success of 0.910 [logs/child_vs_parent_2610/summary.json]. The placement-level paired_success_difference was -0.020, with a 95% t interval of [-0.04645, 0.00645] [logs/child_vs_parent_2610/summary.json]. Its upper bound is below the predicted +0.05, refuting the predeclared magnitude [logs/child_vs_parent_2610/summary.json]. Because the interval includes zero, the direction of any average difference remains inconclusive; this is not evidence that children are worse [logs/child_vs_parent_2610/summary.json].
